evidence.excerpt: Without memory of past attempts, they repeat the same mistakes across tasks, leading to more task failures and longer trajectories.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Across AppWorld, $τ^2$-bench, and AutomationBench, DAEDALUS improves mean success rates by up to 15.9 points and pass^5 by up to 2.2x over a no-memory baseline, and is competitive with methods using training tasks, at a lower inference cost than most.
